title: A small generic toolkit
description:
Write three templates:

- `largestOf(a, b, c)` returns the largest of three values of the same type.
- `isBetween(value, low, high)` returns `true` when `low <= value <= high`.
- `addMixed(a, b)` adds two values that may have **different** types (for example an `int` and a `double`) and returns the natural result type. This one needs two template parameters and an `auto` return type.

starter.solution.cpp: // largestOf, isBetween and addMixed go here.

hints: For `addMixed`: `template <typename T, typename U> auto addMixed(T a, U b) { return a + b; }` The compiler works out the return type from `a + b`.
